title: Unsupervised high-resolution 3D MRI motion correction via physics-informed implicit neural representations

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Unsupervised high-resolution 3D MRI motion correction via physics-informed implicit neural representations》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Motion-corrupted inverse problems remain a central bottleneck in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), especially for high-resolution 3D acquisitions where long readouts couple rigid-body displacement with non-Cartesian k-space sampling.
